name: closedsources
description: Open-source software for finding closed-source software. The irony is included.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/production
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run test:catalog && npm run test:github-collector && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run catalog:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
